paragraphs: See the entry Rav, father of Rav Mesharshiya son of Rav.

notes.text: The heading chains רב אבא אבוה דרב בריה דרב משרשיה, whereas the pointer reads רב אבוה דרב משרשיה בריה דרב. The literal rendering is retained, but the attachment of these father/son phrases and the unnamed Rav remain unresolved. No genealogy or target identity is established here.

In his separate entry headed Rav (vol. III, p. 1038), Hyman identifies the passage as Eruvin 24a and proposes the reordered wording given in this cross-reference. The consulted Davidson text gives the chain in this entry’s heading: Rav Abba speaks in Rava’s name about water in an enclosure. Hyman also reports a variant meaning ‘brother’ in place of ‘father.’ The reordered wording is Hyman’s proposed reading, and the family relationships remain uncertain.
